dimensions.assessment: Affects the Department of Agriculture and interested regional organizations such as trail associations.

dimensions.assessment: The effect is administrative, requiring only a study and report to Congress.
dimensions.evidence: complete and submit to Congress the feasibility study

dimensions.assessment: No specific funding amounts or appropriations are mentioned in the text.
Amends the National Trails System Act strictly to mandate a single feasibility study.
dimensions.evidence: direct the Secretary of Agriculture to conduct a study on the feasibility

dimensions.assessment: Imposes a temporary two-year deadline for completing and submitting the study.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 2 years after the date of the enactment of this paragraph

missing_information: Cost estimates for conducting the feasibility study.
importance_detail.rationale: The legislation requires a feasibility study on designating a specific trail as a national scenic trail within two years.
